name: Evidence gate for drafts and outbound writes
single_source: This file is the ONLY place the rules are written. SKILL.md files point here and do not restate them. Word lists live in lexicon.json next to this file.

binds.outbound: Every tool call that writes to Confluence, Jira or Slack (any mcp__Atlassian_MCP__ / mcp__Atlassian_Rovo__ / mcp__Slack__ tool that is not on the read-only list in lexicon.json). Enforced by the PreToolUse hook scripts/hooks/pre_tool.py.
binds.draft: Every file matching lexicon.json draft_path_patterns (docs/drafts/, docs/**/*draft*, docs/outbound/) that changed since it last passed. Enforced by the Stop hook scripts/hooks/stop.py: the turn cannot end while a changed draft fails.
binds.n8n: n8n write tools need a standing WRITE order (checks B1, B4) but no claims ledger.
binds.not_bound: Chat answers are checked by G-03 (.claude/gates/G-03-chat-claims.json), git / GitHub writes by G-04 (.claude/gates/G-04-repo-write.json). Research notes in the repo are not checked.

pipeline.name: Session start
pipeline.do: Run skill nosm-sync-check: connectors, controlled copies (scripts/sync_check.py), space-wide sweep and live versions of the source-versions table (scripts/sweep_check.py).

pipeline.name: Order
pipeline.do: Nothing to do: the owner's messages are classified from the transcript by scripts/order_check.py rules. READONLY / AMBIGUOUS / STOP means ask, do not write.

pipeline.name: Find every related source
pipeline.do: Search the whole NOSM space (and the Jira issue's comments) for each topic term. Every hit is either read in full or excluded with a reason.

pipeline.name: Read every source to the end, live
pipeline.do: Confluence: getConfluenceContent detail=full. Jira: listJiraIssueComments until isLast, without dropping comments.body. A result saved to a file is read with scripts/read_source.py, every part.

pipeline.name: Write the claims ledger
pipeline.do: docs/ledger/<write_id>.json: one claim per sentence, each with source_id + verbatim quote; counts[] for numbers not stated in the quote; absence{} for 'not / none / 未 / belum' not stated in the quote; unverifiable sentences carry the 🔲 marker.

pipeline.name: Run the gate
pipeline.do: python3 scripts/gate_check.py docs/ledger/<write_id>.json -> exit 0 required. The hook re-runs it at the moment of writing; a PASS printed earlier is not reused.

pipeline.name: Write, then read back
pipeline.do: After a successful write, read the target again (Confluence full read / Jira comment listing). The Stop hook blocks until every sentence of the payload is found in the read-back. The order is marked used automatically.

session_start.why: docs/working-agreement.md rule 23 (owner 2026-09-25): a message that opens with 'hi' is a new day and the start of a session; run every session-start rule and report before anything else. Until 2026-09-25 this was only a reminder printed by prompt.py; nothing held the turn.
session_start.trigger: The owner's latest message starts with 'hi' (prompt.py SESSION_START).
session_start.enforced_by: Stop hook, scripts/hooks/s0.py: the turn cannot end until every item below appears in the transcript AFTER that 'hi' message.
session_start.overrides: OVERRIDE G-01 in the owner's latest message lets the turn end without it.

items.what: nosm-sync-check step 0: docs/working-agreement.md read (Read tool, or a Bash command naming it, with a result)
nosm-sync-check step 1 / CLAUDE.md §〇 items 1-4: a successful mcp__Atlassian_MCP__ call, a successful mcp__Atlassian_Rovo__ read, and a successful mcp__n8n__search_workflows
nosm-sync-check steps 2-3: full reads (detail=full, read to the end) of 1730347066 and 1676804100, and scripts/sync_check.py passing on them
nosm-sync-check step 4: a successful Confluence search whose CQL holds NOSM and lastmodified, and every pageId in docs/source-versions.md read live (scripts/sweep_check.py logic)
CLAUDE.md §〇 acceptance: 04.7 (1691254793) read in full, the page used to find which Project a request type belongs to

known_limits: It proves the steps ran, not that the report came before anything else or that it was correct; the report itself is checked by G-03.

checks.name: CONNECTORS_LIVE
checks.rule: Within 12 h: one successful Atlassian call and one successful n8n search_workflows call in the transcript.

checks.name: CONTROLLED_COPIES_IN_SYNC
checks.rule: scripts/sync_check.py passes on full reads of 07.06 and 04 taken from the transcript, at most 12 h old.

checks.name: SPACE_SWEEP_RUN
checks.rule: Within 12 h: a successful Confluence search whose CQL contains NOSM and lastmodified, AND every page with a pageId in docs/source-versions.md read live (getConfluenceContent, any detail, or listConfluenceContentVersions) - scripts/sweep_check.py. The recorded version is only compared, never trusted (owner decision 2026-09-25).

checks.name: ORDER_STANDING
checks.rule: The latest owner message classified WRITE (outbound) or WRITE/DRAFT (draft) exists. Outbound: every later owner message is a plain CONFIRM. Draft: no later STOP, and the order is at most windows_minutes.draft_order_age old (an order for earlier work does not authorise a new draft).

checks.name: ORDER_UNUSED
checks.rule: Outbound: the order is not recorded as used in docs/orders/consumed.jsonl (one order = one write). The PostToolUse hook records it.

checks.name: ORDER_MATCHES_TARGET
checks.rule: If the order names page ids or issue keys, the target must be one of them.

checks.name: NOT_BACKEND_OPS_ACCOUNT
checks.rule: No write through mcp__Atlassian_Rovo__ (Backend Operations account). Owner instruction 2026-09-22.

checks.name: PAYLOAD_IS_WHAT_WAS_GATED
checks.rule: The tool input is byte-identical (canonical JSON) to the ledger's payload_file; for a draft, the file itself is the payload.

checks.name: TARGET_IS_WHAT_WAS_GATED
checks.rule: The tool call's page / issue / channel equals the ledger target.

checks.name: DISCOVERY_DONE
checks.rule: discovery.calls are real, successful search calls within the source window; every topic_term appears in some query; at least one is a space=NOSM Confluence search.

checks.name: DISCOVERY_PAGINATED
checks.rule: No search result that says more pages exist (hasNextPage / isLast=false / next link / total > returned) is left without its later pages.

checks.name: DISCOVERY_COVERED
checks.rule: Every page, issue and comment the searches returned is a source or is in discovery.excluded with a reason of at least 15 characters.

checks.name: SOURCES_READ_LIVE
checks.rule: Each source points at real read calls of the right tool and object, successful, within 60 min (outbound) / 12 h (draft); Confluence reads are detail=full and no later call shows a different version. Repo notes and memory are never sources.

checks.name: SOURCES_READ_TO_END
checks.rule: A result saved to a file counts as read only if every read_source.py part printed its END marker. Jira comments: pages from startAt 0 to isLast with no gap.

checks.name: EVERY_SENTENCE_CLAIMED
checks.rule: Every sentence of the payload / draft is a claim sentence, a boilerplate sentence, or (Confluence edits) text already on the page as last read.

checks.name: QUOTES_VERBATIM
checks.rule: Each non-🔲 claim names a verified source and a quote of >= 6 characters found verbatim in that source's text as read.

checks.name: NUMBERS_QUOTED_OR_RECOUNTED
checks.rule: Every number in a claim (digits, Chinese numerals, Indonesian/English words) appears in the quote; a quantity (number + unit) must appear in the quote as a quantity or be recounted here by counts[{value, source_id, regex, section?}].

checks.name: ABSENCE_PROVEN
checks.rule: A claim with absence wording not present in its own quote needs absence{pattern, searched:[>=2 calls], control:{call, pattern}}: the pattern is absent from every searched result, the control pattern is present in the control result, same tool.

checks.name: NAMES_EXACT
checks.rule: A near-name term (lexicon near_name_groups) used in a claim must appear in the quote exactly; a page code (04.10, 04.9.1) must be a source's title code or appear in the quote.

checks.name: BOILERPLATE_CARRIES_NO_FACT
checks.rule: Boilerplate has no absence wording and no numbers except structural labels.

checks.name: NO_BLAME
checks.rule: No sentence names a person together with fault wording (owner instruction 2026-09-21, docs/working-agreement.md rule 18).

checks.name: TARGET_READ_BEFORE_WRITE
checks.rule: Confluence edit: a full read of the target within the window and its latest seen version equals the edit's snapshotToken. Jira comment: the issue's comments read to isLast within the window.

checks.name: READ_BACK_AFTER_WRITE
checks.rule: Stop hook: after a successful outbound write, a later read of the target must contain every payload sentence.

checks.name: LEDGER_VALID
checks.rule: ledger.kind is outbound or draft.

ledger_schema.target: {system: confluence, content_id} | {system: jira_comment, issue} | {system: slack, channel} | {system: draft, path}
ledger_schema.tool: outbound only: the exact tool name
ledger_schema.payload_file: outbound only: docs/ledger/<write_id>.payload.json = the exact tool input
ledger_schema.claims: [{id, text, source_id, quote, counts?: [{value, source_id, regex, section?}], absence?: {pattern, searched: [..], control: {call, pattern}}}]

overrides.OVERRIDE G-01: Only the owner can type it. When the owner's latest message contains it, the hook lets one blocked outbound write through and logs it.
overrides.UNLOCK G-01: Only the owner can type it. Needed in the owner's latest message before any change to the gate files (lexicon.json protected_paths).

root_causes.R1_version_noted_not_read: 04.10 moved v19->v20; the number was recorded, the page was not opened; v40 then asked for evidence that v20 already contained. Closed by C4/C5/E1 (reads are taken from the transcript, not recorded by hand).
root_causes.R2_claim_without_source: Rules written that no page states. Closed by D1/D2.
root_causes.R3_number_inferred: 'SLA 17 条' - actually 16 rows. Closed by D3.
root_causes.R4_near_names_merged: 'PIP 参数' written as built because 'PIP Extension 参数' was built. Closed by D5.
root_causes.R5_absence_as_conclusion: 'no 切分审计 found' and stopped. Closed by D4.
root_causes.R6_sources_not_enumerated: c50237 read only after the wrong claim was out. Closed by C1/C2/C3.
root_causes.R7_check_order_used_as_write_order: v39: 'Kau audit detail menyeluruh sampai habis' treated as permission to write. Closed by B1.
root_causes.R8_self_declared_evidence: Gate v2 accepted read_scope, read_at, count_output and the order text as typed by the model; one sweep entry carried a read_at hours in the future. Closed by taking every one of them from the transcript.

known_limits: Chat answers are checked by G-03 only as far as its own known_limits allow (tokens, quotes and absence wording; not the meaning of a sentence).
A quote proves the words exist in the source, not that the claim reads them correctly.

Order classification is a word list: a real order may be refused (safe), and an insult containing 'tulis' was classified WRITE in the session replay (unsafe, but it still needs the full evidence gate and is used up after one write).
Hooks are loaded by Claude Code from .claude/settings.json; if the harness does not load them, nothing is enforced and the gate depends on being run by hand.

Gate-file lock on Bash: a command naming a protected path is blocked, and so is a git command that would stage, commit, restore or discard a changed protected path without naming it (git commit -a, git add ., git stash, git reset --hard; checked against git status, not the command text). A program that writes a protected file without naming it cannot be seen before it runs; instead every hook (before each tool call, after each Bash / Write / Edit, at Stop) compares the protected files with a sealed copy kept outside the repo (~/.claude/g01-state/, scripts/hooks/_guard.py) and, without UNLOCK G-01, puts back the sealed content and refuses the call. The protected list is taken from the sealed lexicon, so changing lexicon.json cannot unprotect anything. Limits: (a) a change is undone at the next hook, not prevented, so it exists for the rest of that command or background job; (b) the hooks, the sealed copy and the model run as the same OS user, so a program written to disable the hook code or the sealed copy itself in one step is not stopped - this guards against accidents and shortcuts, not a deliberate attack; (c) the sealed copy is lost with the container and is re-made from the fresh clone at the first hook. docs/ledger/_draft-registry.json is rewritten by the Stop hook on every draft PASS, so committing it needs UNLOCK G-01.
